title: Surviving hypothesis
description: A candidate connection that passed every gate of the falsification gauntlet. Written to hypotheses.json. Each carries the support that justifies surfacing it: a fully fragment-cited bridge chain, the searches that failed to find it (novelty), the disconfirmation it survived, and a discriminating experiment.

statement.description: The novel A-C hypothesis in one sentence, stated as testable and falsifiable.

bridge_chain.description: The mechanistic path from A to C. EVERY step must cite a fragment_id present in the run's fragment store — an orphan step fails gate G2 and the run.

corpus_diversity.description: Distinct source corpora the bridge draws on. >=2 required for a cross-corpus connection.

queries.description: The exact direct-claim searches issued at gate G1.

direct_claim_found.description: Must be false for a surviving hypothesis (undiscovered-public-knowledge test).

disconfirming_searched.description: Disconfirming evidence actively sought at gate G3 (failed trials, opposing signatures, counter-mechanisms).

experimental_test.description: A concrete, discriminating experiment: the prediction, and the result that would FALSIFY the hypothesis.

scores.description: Bridge signals: independent_paths, corpus_diversity, semantic_distance, confidence_product.
